en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing three African men in traditional attire. One man sits on the shoulders of another, holding an umbrella, while a third man stands nearby. In the background, there are thatched-roof structures typical of rural African settings. The border of the postcard features the publisher information at the top and a caption at the bottom.
